assertions.evidence: Assigns literal-string checks to oracle: 'grep either finds them or it doesn't'; judgment calls to judge: 'earned-versus-decorative or mechanism-quality judgments to LLM judges'
Names keyword-gaming risk: 'A model tuned against that harness learns to avoid the token, not the failure: it keeps the unearned emphasis and renames it'
Names judge-side bias: 'a judge is itself a fluent model... can be swayed by confident, well-cadenced prose the same way the skill tells a human editor to distrust it'
Interprets zero hits as drift not victory: 'Once model output moves off... the detector doesn't report clean; it reports obsolete' and distinguishes from broken detector
Recommends re-profiling time-dated list: 'Demote ai-vocabulary to a low-weight legacy check... keeping the score tied to the judgment the lists exist to approximate'
Keeps oracle as recall, judgment as verdict: 'keeping the score tied to the judgment... when one word list ages out the way delve did, the eval notices the gap'
